title: The Ship's Log

reward.description: A raven-feather quill that never runs dry. It writes slightly neater than you do.

hints: with open(path, "w") as f: opens a file for writing (erasing what was there). Use "a" to add to the end instead, and "r" to read.
f.write(entry + "\n") writes one line. When reading, line.rstrip("\n") removes the newline.
To handle a missing file, wrap the open() in try / except FileNotFoundError and return [].
